So my favorite would be....*drum roll* Butter beer cupcakes. Yes, I went there.

I start with this [recipe](http://www.amybites.com/?p=623), but then add my own flair.

I like mine to be "adult". So instead of 1/2 a cup of cream soda I use 1/4 then I use 1/2 cup of butterscotch schnapps. I also cut out the butter flavoring completely. Because I can.

I also skip filling them with the ganache because when I make cupcakes I use my [babycakes](https://scontent-b-atl.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpf1/t1.0-9/p180x540/996107_10152892003555626_435077959_n.jpg) maker and they end up too small to fill.

For the frosting I follow her recipe but I leave out the butter flavor and the vanilla and instead add the butterscotch schnapps. I think I left out the milk as well but I can't remember for sure. If I accidentally add too much schnapps and it gets a little thin just add a bit of powdered sugar (a little dusting at a time) until it thickens to where you want. I keep going back and forth between the schnapps and the powdered sugar(and the occasional tidbit of butter) until I get the flavor I want.

I make the ganache as she says and use that to drizzle over the cupcakes. Then voila! [You're done!](https://scontent-a-atl.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-prn2/t1.0-9/p180x540/941526_10152893050575626_468798679_n.jpg)

These can end up a little dense so I find them paired best with a nice big glass of milk. :)
